document.title: Petrol prices rise in Lagos as depot supply tightens
document.text:
Petrol prices rise in Lagos as depot supply tightens

LAGOS, 12 September 2026. Petrol now sells for N1,020 per litre at most filling stations in Lagos, up from N940 per litre in August, according to a survey by the station owners' association. The association said tighter supply at depots was behind the increase. In Abuja, pump prices averaged N1,055 per litre on Friday.

Separately, the electricity regulator said the Band A tariff for Ikeja Electric customers will remain at N209.5 per kWh through October. Analysts expect prices to rise further next month.
